definitions.explanation: A line of houses along a street, viewed as a collective sight. Often used to describe the character or atmosphere of a neighborhood or historical district.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{家並|いえな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
⟦{城下町|じょうかまち}→城下町：12105_joukamachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{家並|いえな}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk through the beautiful streetscape of the castle town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{家並|いえな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This district, where the Edo-period streetscape has been preserved, is popular with tourists.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in descriptions of traditional or historical neighborhoods where rows of houses create a distinctive scene. Common in travel writing and descriptions of preserved historical districts ({伝統的建造物群保存地区|でんとうてきけんぞうぶつぐんほぞんちく}). Also written as {家並|やな}み in some contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{家並|いえな}み: old row of houses
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{家並|いえな}み: beautiful streetscape
- {家並|いえな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: rows of houses stretch on
- {家並|いえな}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to preserve the streetscape
